study type: individual participant data meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCT)
exposure: neonatal enteral supplementation with high-dose docosahexaenoic acid (DHA)
cohort: The study included 1801 very preterm infants (GA 26.7 ± 1.5 wk) from two randomized controlled trials, comparing high-dose DHA supplementation with placebo.
finding: Neonatal enteral supplementation with high-dose DHA was not significantly associated with severe BPD in very preterm infants.
